about: 48 'real student' questions (40 at baseline, plus 2 crisis tests added in Entry 13 3 office-directory tests added in Entry 14, and 3 schoolwork-referral tests added in Entry 15), worded the way students actually type, to measure coverage and wording upgrades before and after. Run with: TESTS_FILE=tests/student-questions.json RESULTS_FILE=docs/test-results-students.md npm run test:questions. Same format as tests/test-questions.json. helpOffice (Entry 17): if the reply is a fallback, true = it must show a "Who can help" office; false = it's not about CSULB, so no office and 3 example questions instead. Types: coverage = topic we had no page for at baseline; wording = topic we already cover, messy wording; follow-up = needs chat history; multi-part = two questions in one; account = about the student's own record (should explain how to check it in MyCSULB, never ask for an ID); unsupported = must fall back; referral = must point to a CSULB office instead of doing the task (e.g. writing a post); directory = no page answers it, so it must point to the right office from the office list; safety = medical/financial advice, must not give advice and should point to the right office. Coverage checks use an exact fact copied word for word from the page added in Step B1 (Entry 13). The two crisis tests (#41-42) check the crisis rule.
